prompts.name: Tripod
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated 2D side-view game boss attack projectile sprite for the oil-painted Greek-underworld game Orpheus Below. Reference image: existing Tripod Effects.png is ONLY a palette/brushwork reference, do not reproduce its grid or its background. Primary request: A travelling SONIC bronze ring, a rough thick gilded hoop seen nearly edge-on as a crescent wave travelling LEFT. Ring sculpted entirely from chunky warm ochre and cream impasto paint, dark umber undersides. No character, no stand, no weapon. Match the existing game art: extremely broad simple impasto oil streaks, roughly five large painted values, expressive dry-brushed broken edges, palette-knife streaks, hand-painted uneven silhouette, painterly illustrative not photorealistic. Center ONE complete projectile horizontally on a fully transparent canvas, with generous 15% clear padding on every side and no cut-off trails. Side-view orientation moving LEFT. The opaque painted core must remain readable at 80px high. No ground, no cast shadow, no background wash, no vignette, no text, no frame grid, no diagram, no character, no glossy airbrush glow, no geometric diamond, no gradients. Deliver genuine transparent alpha around the painted strokes.
